risks: (a) The suite reads I2's `.claude` list as name, description and metadata. It assumes `.claude` copies and vendored skills need no `version`, which I1-I4 imply from the live tree but don't state. (b) `test_i1_every_finding_carries_code_file_key_and_message` reads I1 as covering every finding. So the engineer must add `file` and `key` to the old findings too (body length, unknown command and the others).
